name: I'll Have You Know Spongebob
look: A still from SpongeBob SquarePants: SpongeBob, with half-closed eyes and a smug, condescending expression, raises one index finger as if making a point, his mouth slightly open, against a blue sky with flower-shaped clouds.
use: A smug correction or boast. The top usually starts with 'I'll have you know' and the bottom finishes with a proud claim that is actually unimpressive, or a know-it-all correction nobody asked for.
slots: bottom caption: the unimpressive boast or correction
examples: I only hit snooze four times today
I read the first page of the instructions
describe: spongebob raising one finger with a smug look
smug sponge holding up his finger to make a point
spongebob with half closed eyes correcting someone
cartoon sponge with a condescending face and pointer finger up
spongebob about to say well actually
